cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/process-compose.done
nohup bash -c 'PC_DISABLE_TUI=true TERM=xterm-256color uv run --locked poe process-compose -t=false > /tmp/process-compose.log 2>&1; echo "PC_EXIT=$?" > /tmp/process-compose.done' &
